test_objectives.name: Employee cannot complete onboarding without selecting a BenefitPlan
Plan dropdown shows only BenefitPlans that belong to the Employee's Tenant

test_cases.title: Verify Finish stays disabled when no benefit plan is selected
ac_text: Given an Employee mid-onboarding with no BenefitPlan selected, when they view the wizard, then the Finish button is disabled.
test_cases.notes: No produced spec under src/tests/ yet. golden_dataset/clean is reviewer calibration, not traceability.

steps.result: Wizard loads with the plan-selection step visible
Finish is disabled and cannot be clicked

test_cases.title: Verify Finish becomes enabled after a tenant plan is selected
ac_text: Given an Employee selects a BenefitPlan belonging to their own Tenant, when the selection completes, then the Finish button becomes enabled.

steps.action: Select a BenefitPlan from the dropdown
steps.result: Plan is selected and the dropdown closes
Finish is enabled and onboarding proceeds

test_cases.title: Verify no cross-tenant BenefitPlan is visible in the dropdown
ac_text: Given a Growth-tier Tenant, when the Employee opens the plan dropdown, then only BenefitPlans belonging to that Tenant are listed (no cross-tenant leakage).
test_cases.notes: No produced spec under src/tests/ yet. golden_dataset/clean is reviewer calibration, not traceability.
preconditions: Tenants.growth01 — Growth-tier Tenant A with its own BenefitPlans
Tenants.growth02 — a second Tenant B with different plans

steps.action: Open the plan-selection dropdown as an Employee of Tenant A
steps.result: Only Tenant A's plans are listed — none from Tenant B
